content_sections.heading: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available across four sports disciplines under the Khelo India Scheme of SAI (Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports).

content_sections.heading: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility criteria differ based on whether the applicant applies under Individual Sports or Team Sports.

rows.qualification_required: 1st preference: Represented India at recognized international competition under recognized NSF/Association of respective sport. 2nd preference: Medal winner at Senior National Past championship conducted by recognized NSF OR Medal winner at Khelo India Games. 3rd preference: Medal winner at National AIU past championship. 4th preference: Represented State in Senior National Past championship conducted by recognized NSF OR Participation in Khelo India Games.

1st preference: Represented India at recognized international competition under recognized NSF/Association of respective sport. 2nd preference: Part of medal winning team at Senior National past championship conducted by recognized NSF OR Part of medal winning team at Khelo India Games. 3rd preference: Part of medal winning team at National AIU past championship. 4th preference: Represented State in Senior National past championship conducted by recognized NSF OR Participation in Khelo India Games.

content_sections.heading: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit for applicants will be 40 years. However, relaxation may be accorded in deserving cases. Not specified in the notification beyond relaxation in deserving cases.

content_sections.heading: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: No TA/DA shall be admissible for interview and joining the assignment. No other facilities like DA, accommodation, residential phone, conveyance/ transport, personal staff, medical reimbursement, HRA, and LTC etc. would be admissible.

rows.pay_level_pay: Fixed monthly remuneration of Rs. 25,000/- i.e. Rs. 3.00 lakh per annum.

content_sections.heading: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Panjab University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification PDF and application form from the official links. Fill out the application form with all required educational, personal, and sports achievement details. Attach self-attested copies of eligible educational, professional, sports achievement certificates, ID proof, and Aadhar Card. Affix an attested photograph on the application form. Submit the duly completed application form by hand, Regd. Post, or Speed Post to the office of Director, 1st Floor in the Directorate of Sports, Panjab University, Chandigarh on or before 17 October 2026 up to 5.00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original educational certificates Professional certificates Sports achievement certificates ID proof Aadhar Card

content_sections.heading: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 Important Conditions
content_sections.text: The contractual engagement will be initially for a period of 02 years, which could be further extended on the basis of performance. Tax deduction at source (TDS) or any other tax liable will be deducted as per prevailing rules before effecting payment. Performance of the selected candidates will be continuously reviewed and their extension will be considered on the basis of periodic review/requirement. This appointment will be on contract basis and does not confer any right to claim to permanent employment in Panjab University, Chandigarh. The competent authority reserves the right to terminate the contract by giving 30 days notice if performance is not found satisfactory, and may withdraw the offer at any time without assigning any reason. Candidates who have earlier applied as per notice no. 3656/DS dated 07.08.2025 need not be applied again.

faq.question: Q1. What is Panjab University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment drive inviting applications for 4 Coach and Past Champion Athlete positions under the Khelo India Scheme.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Panjab University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies are available for Badminton (1), Football (1), Swimming (1), and Kabaddi (1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Panjab University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 17 October 2026 up to 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Panjab University Coach Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have represented India at a recognized international competition, won a medal at a Senior National, Khelo India, or AIU championship, or represented a State in a Senior National championship depending on individual or team sports criteria.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Panjab University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years, with relaxations in deserving cases.
